description: Drops the redundant 'more' before a closed whitelist of synthetic -er comparatives (better, easier, faster, …) for Vietlish double-marking, where the analytic 'hơn' is wrongly realized as 'more' on top of an already-comparative adjective.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Removes 'more' only before a fixed whitelist of irregular/short comparatives where double-marking is ungrammatical. Analytic comparatives that REQUIRE 'more' (more careful / more beautiful / more important), 'more' + noun ('more water'), and 'the more the better' never match. The result is re-capitalized when the match is sentence-initial.

positive.notes: Synthetic -ier comparative keeps its own ending; only 'more' is removed.
Mid-sentence double comparative, no re-capitalization needed.
Sentence-initial match — the new first letter is re-capitalized.

negative.notes: Analytic comparative — 'more careful' is correct and 'carefuler' does not exist.
Long adjective requires analytic 'more'; not on the -er whitelist.
Correlative construction — 'more' and 'better' are not adjacent, so no double-mark.
